question: One-stop or two-stop, and how to split the stints, to minimise race time?
success_criterion: Agent PASSES if its recommended strategy is valid and its simulated race time is within tolerance_pct of optimal_total_time_s.
notes: Optimum = argmin of the deterministic simulator over SOFT-starting 1- and 2-stop strategies (min stint 10 laps). The simple model favours running the faster SOFT compound; the tolerance criterion rewards any near-optimal plan the agent reaches via the tools.
